rules: The USD2 case budget includes all preparation/auth smoke, failures, retries and cache usage.
Before a call confirm authoritative prior actual usage, in-flight/unknown reservations and conservative per-call maximum.
Stop before next call when actual usage plus outstanding/unknown reservations plus next-call upper bound approaches USD2.
Unknown cost remains unknown; retain its conservative reservation and hold further calls.
Record provider-reported usage and cost even when output validation fails; retain invoice uncertainty separately.
JEV mock five-dollar invariant is historical test specification, not permission to spend; zero live JEV calls until individually assigned.
No top-up or automatic model fallback/retry without parent-approved configuration and accounting.
